answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The zenith is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ridge. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit. What survives to the violet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
